name: Disc Cube
short_description: 16mm cube-dicing grid disc for Skymsen continuous-feed vegetable processors, working with a matching slicing disc to cut uniform 16×16mm cubes for salsas, stews and soups.
description:
The Skymsen GC16 is a cube-dicing grid disc for Skymsen's continuous-feed vegetable processors, cutting produce into uniform 16 × 16 mm cubes.

Like other cube grids in the range, the GC16 is a cross-hatched grid rather than a stand-alone blade: fitted behind a slicing disc of matching thickness, the slicer cuts even slices which the grid then divides into cubes as they pass through, producing a consistent dice in a single pass. It suits potatoes, carrots, onions, peppers and other firm vegetables destined for salsas, stews, salads and soups.

  • Works together with a matching slicing disc to produce a finished dice
  • Compact grid, approximately 210 × 220 × 12 mm, net weight around 0.51 kg
  • Tool-free fitting and removal for washdown between tasks

The Skymsen PA-7 is the workhorse vegetable preparation machine for restaurants, hotels, institutional kitchens and catering operations that need consistent, standardised cuts at volume.

A 0.5 HP motor drives a 203 mm disc at 440 rpm, processing up to 250 kg of produce per hour - the equivalent of several prep cooks, without the variability. The seven-disc set covers slicing at 1 mm and 3 mm, grating at 3, 5 and 8 mm, a fine grater for chocolate and coconut, and a 7×7 mm julienne disc for chips and salads.

The drum is lined with abrasive emery on both the rotating disc and the cylinder wall, so the potatoes are tumbled against the abrasive rather than cut - the skin is stripped away while the flesh underneath is left whole, and the waste is rinsed out through the drain.

Peeling by machine is what makes a potato-heavy menu workable at volume. A load runs in minutes and comes out consistent no matter who is on shift, where hand peeling ties up staff and wastes more of every potato. The motor is mounted outside the bowl so it can be reached for service without stripping the machine down.

Built in stainless steel throughout, on a heavy-duty chassis with castors so it can be rolled clear of the wall for cleaning.

short_description: Heavy-duty commercial potato peeler taking 25 kg per load, with emery lining on the disc and cylinder wall, an externally mounted motor for easy servicing and a stainless steel body on castors.
description:
A heavy-duty commercial potato peeler taking 25 kg of potatoes per load. The drum is lined with abrasive emery on both the rotating disc and the cylinder wall, so the potatoes are tumbled against the abrasive rather than cut - the skin is stripped away while the flesh underneath is left whole, and the waste is rinsed out through the drain.

Peeling by machine is what makes a potato-heavy menu workable at volume. A load runs in minutes and comes out consistent no matter who is on shift, where hand peeling ties up staff and wastes more of every potato. The motor is mounted outside the bowl so it can be reached for service without stripping the machine down.

Built in stainless steel throughout, on a heavy-duty chassis with castors so it can be rolled clear of the wall for cleaning.

  • Emery lining on both the disc and the cylinder wall
  • Externally mounted motor for easy servicing

  • All stainless steel construction on a heavy-duty chassis

A rotating disc feeds fruit from the 15 kg stainless steel basket into the chute one at a time, then cuts, squeezes and separates juice from pulp in a single pass.

Juice and peel never come into contact, so peel acids never reach the glass and the juice keeps its fresh flavour. Peel drops away into the open side bins while juice runs straight into the glass on the drip tray. Removable components are dishwasher safe, and a safety switch on the front cover stops the machine the moment the cover is opened.

Key Features

  • Fully automatic feed, cut, squeeze and pulp separation from one button
  • Squeezes up to 38 oranges per minute
  • 15 kg stainless steel fruit basket; 28 kg hopper optional
  • Takes fruit from 60 to 80 mm in diameter
  • Juice and peel never touch, preserving the flavour of the juice
  • Safety switch cuts the machine when the front cover is opened

description:
Blast chilling is the single biggest lever a professional kitchen has over food safety and food cost, and the Tecnodom ALADINO brings it within reach of a mid-sized operation.

Driving cooked food through the danger band in about an hour, rather than leaving it to cool in ambient air, arrests bacterial growth, holds moisture in the product, and lets a kitchen cook in planned batches instead of scrambling to order. Five levels of GN 1/1 or 600 × 400 mm suit a busy restaurant, hotel breakfast operation, patisserie or butchery without demanding the floor space of a roll-in cabinet.

Both a chamber probe and a core probe ship in the box, so cycles terminate on true product core temperature rather than a timer - the difference between a properly stabilised product and a guess.

  • Defrost with the door open - no heaters, no hot gas
  • AISI 304 stainless inside and out, rounded internal corners

name: Bulk Milk Chiller 500 Litres BMC-500
short_description: 500-litre direct-expansion bulk milk chiller with an AISI 304 stainless steel tank, timer-controlled agitator and 2.7 kW single-phase supply. Chills a full batch from about 37 to 4 degrees Celsius in 5 hours.
description:
The Ice Make BMC-500 is a 500-litre bulk milk chiller for dairy farms and milk collection points - a horizontal AISI 304 stainless steel tank on a stand, with the air-cooled condensing unit mounted underneath.

Cooling is direct expansion through a dimple-jacket evaporator forming the base and sides of the tank, so refrigerant works straight against the milk-contact surface. A full batch drops from milking temperature to 4 °C in five hours, and the insulation then holds it: lose power and the milk rises no more than 3 °C over twelve hours.

It runs single-phase at 2.7 kW, so no three-phase connection is needed - a real advantage at rural collection points. Give it a dedicated circuit: running current is 13-14 A and compressor inrush is several times that.

Key Features

  • 500 litre AISI 304 tank, welded, polished and sloped to the drain
  • Direct-expansion cooling through a dimple-jacket evaporator
  • 37 to 4 °C in 5 hours, then holds 12 hours unpowered
  • Timer-controlled agitator - 1 minute in every 15
  • 230 V single phase - no three-phase supply required
  • Dip-stick and calibration chart supplied

The HK-Redline CT-3 is a conveyor toaster rated at 450 slices an hour, for hotel breakfast buffets, canteens and busy cafes where a slot toaster cannot keep up. Bread goes in one end and comes out toasted at the other, continuously, without anyone timing it.

Belt speed is adjustable, which is how browning is set: slower for darker toast, faster for lighter. Toast can be discharged at the front or the back, so the machine suits either a self-service buffet or a staffed pass. A geared motor with a cooling fan drives the belt, and there is a stainless steel crumb collector with a handle. It draws 2.64 kW at 220-240 V, weighs 20.5 kg and measures 468 × 418 × 387 mm.

short_description: Attachable solution tank for TASKI ergodisc single-disc machines, feeding cleaning solution through the centre of the brush. Fits ergodisc 165, HD and duo.
description:
The water tank is the accessory that turns an ergodisc from a buffing and polishing machine into a scrubbing machine.

Without it, solution has to be spread on the floor manually before the disc passes over it - wasteful, uneven and slow. With it, solution is metered through the centre of the brush directly into the working zone, so chemical consumption drops and cleaning is consistent across the pass.

The tank clips onto the machine body without tools, in keeping with the rest of the ergodisc accessory system, and has a large fill opening for fast refills from a bucket or hose. TASKI's own literature calls it the best accessory for wet scrubbing and deep cleaning, so it is best treated as a companion purchase alongside the machine rather than an optional extra.

  • Feeds solution through the centre of the brush, where the disc is working
  • Large fill opening for fast refills without a funnel
  • Converts a dry single-disc machine into a wet-scrubbing machine
  • Fits the whole ergodisc range, so tanks are shared across a fleet

TASKI ergodisc 165, ergodisc HD and ergodisc duo per the official accessories chart; distributor sources additionally list ergodisc 175, 200 and 400.

The TASKI swingo 250µicro attacks the single largest inefficiency in commercial cleaning - the mop, which redeposits dirty water, leaves floors wet and hazardous, and delivers inconsistent results.

It fits the same operational niche - grab it, clean a small area, put it away - while scrubbing with twin counter-rotating brushes and vacuuming the soil straight back off the floor. At 44 cm wide and 25 kg it goes where a conventional scrubber dryer cannot: behind retail counters, into washrooms, up stairs to a mezzanine.

The economics are labour and water. One operator covers 1,320 m² an hour instead of the few hundred a mop manages, and each 2.2 litre fill treats over 600 m², with dirty water captured in a sealed tank rather than poured back on the floor. The trade-off: the tanks are small, so this is for frequent small-area cleaning, not scrubbing a warehouse.

name: Taski Balimat 45 Sweeper
short_description: Manual push sweeper with twin counter-rotating brushes and a 40 litre hopper, sweeping up to five times faster than a broom with no power, batteries or fuel.
description:
The TASKI balimat 45 is a purely mechanical push sweeper built for operators who need broom-replacement productivity without any running costs.

Pushing the machine drives twin counter-rotating cylindrical brushes, while the side brushes sweep debris in from kerbs, corners and edges into the sweeping path. Everything is thrown into a 40-litre detachable hopper that lifts out for emptying. Because there is no motor, battery or cable, it starts working the moment it is picked up and can be used in wet conditions where a vacuum sweeper could not.

At 13 kg it is light enough for one person to carry up steps or lift into a vehicle, and the handle folds down so it stores in a cupboard. It suits shop entrances, hotel forecourts, school corridors, warehouse aprons and building perimeters - anywhere a broom is currently used over a moderate area.

Key Features

  • Fully manual - no power, batteries or fuel
  • Up to five times faster than a conventional broom
  • Twin counter-rotating cylindrical main brushes with side brushes funnelling debris inward
  • 470 mm main brush path, up to 800 mm with both side brushes fitted
  • Works indoors and outdoors, including in wet conditions
  • Just 13 kg, with a folding handle for compact storage

name: Water Softeners DP2
category: Coffee Machines > Semi Automatic > Semi Automatic Accessories
short_description: Water softener that strips calcium and magnesium out of the supply, preventing limescale in espresso machines, dishwashers and boilers. Simple to service and extends equipment life.
description:
Protect your coffee equipment and commercial appliances from hard water damage with the Water Softener DP2. Designed to reduce water hardness by removing calcium and magnesium minerals, it helps prevent limescale buildup, improves equipment efficiency, and extends the lifespan of espresso machines, dishwashers, boilers, and other water-fed appliances.

Hard water is the single biggest cause of premature failure in espresso machines, combi ovens and dishwashers. Calcium and magnesium precipitate out as scale on every heated surface, insulating elements and narrowing pipework until performance drops and a service call follows.

This is a manual ion-exchange softener rather than a throwaway cartridge: an 8 litre resin cylinder that the operator regenerates periodically with roughly a kilogram of salt. It is sized for a single machine or a small bank of equipment, and standing 400 mm tall on a 190 mm diameter it will sit in an under-counter cupboard.

Key Features

  • Reduces Water Hardness
  • Protects Equipment
  • Improves Performance by enhancing heating efficiency and water flow.
  • Reliable operation with simple servicing.
  • Commercial Grade

short_description: Professional stainless steel espresso tamper for even, consistent compression of the coffee bed, which is the basis of a balanced extraction.
description:
Achieve consistent espresso quality with the Stainless Steel Coffee Tamper, a professional barista accessory designed for precise coffee compression. Built from durable stainless steel, this tamper ensures even distribution and compacting of ground coffee for improved extraction and a richer espresso experience.

Compression is the step that decides whether water passes evenly through the coffee bed or channels through its weakest point. An under- or over-tamped basket will pull sour or bitter no matter how good the grinder and the machine are, which is why tamping technique is the first thing taught behind a bar.

Stainless steel is specified for tampers because it holds an exact flat edge, carries enough mass to compress the puck without the barista forcing it, does not absorb coffee oils, and wipes down between services.

short_description: 16-compartment glass rack supplied with 1 extender, moulded in food-contact certified polypropylene. Base rack 50.1 × 50.1 × 10.1 cm, with each extender adding 8.25 cm.
description:
A 16-compartment glass rack supplied with 1 extender, for washing and then storing glassware in a commercial dishwasher. The base rack is 50.1 × 50.1 cm and 10.1 cm deep; each extender adds 8.25 cm of usable height, so the stack is built to suit the glass rather than the glass forced to suit the rack.

Compartments earn their place twice over. Glasses never touch one another, which is what causes chipped rims and the fine scratches that turn into cloudiness; and each glass is held upright so the spray reaches inside the bowl instead of only the outside. A 16-compartment layout gives cells of roughly 11.2 × 11.2 cm, which suits larger wine glasses and tumblers.

Moulded in food-contact certified polypropylene, with inclined drain windows in the base so water runs out rather than pooling. Racks and extenders interlock, so a loaded stack can be carried and shelved as one.

short_description: Four-burner countertop gas range with cast-iron star burners, 25,000 BTU/hr each and 100,000 BTU/hr total, flame-failure protection and battery piezo ignition. H-Kitchen EHP-4S.
description:
The EHP-4S is a four-burner countertop gas range for kitchens that need boiling and stockpot capacity without giving up floor space. At 600 mm wide and 690 mm deep it sits on an existing bench or stand, and the 340 mm height keeps pan rims at a comfortable working level.

Each octagonal cast-iron star burner is rated 25,000 BTU/hr, giving 100,000 BTU/hr across the top and enough heat to hold four pans at a rolling boil together. Burner heads lift off for cleaning, and every burner has its own flame-failure device that cuts the gas if a flame goes out.

Ignition is battery piezo on each burner, so no electrical supply is needed. The range is supplied for natural gas, with an LPG conversion kit available.

Key Features

  • Four 25,000 BTU/hr burners, 100,000 BTU/hr total
  • Cast-iron star burners with lift-off heads
  • Flame-failure device fitted to every burner
  • Battery piezo ignition needs no electrical supply
  • 305 x 305 mm cast-iron grates carry stockpots
  • Natural gas as supplied, LPG conversion kit available

name: Gas Burners with Oven and 24 Inch Griddle/Salamander
short_description: Freestanding gas range combining four 30,000 BTU/hr cast-iron open-top burners, a 24-inch griddle plate on two 20,000 BTU/hr burners, and two independent 31,000 BTU/hr ovens with 250-550°F thermostats.
description:
This HDS gas range combines open-top burners, a 24" griddle and dual ovens in one freestanding unit, for kitchens that need cooktop, griddle and oven cooking in a single footprint. It's part of the same HDSGR range as the standard burner-only ranges (see HDSGR-36), offered here in 36" and 60" griddle-equipped widths.

Four open-top burners - 30,000 BTU/hr cast-iron burners with lift-off heads - sit alongside a 3/4" thick, 24" griddle plate heated by two 20,000 BTU/hr U-shaped burners, all on a fully MIG-welded stainless steel frame with a deep range top and pull-out crumb tray.

Below, two independent ovens each run on a 31,000 BTU/hr U-shaped burner, with thermostats adjustable from 250-550°F (121-288°C) and two racks across four positions per oven, sized for full-size sheet pans in either orientation.

Key Features

  • 4 open-top burners, 30,000 BTU/hr cast-iron each, lift-off heads
  • 24" griddle plate, 3/4" thick, two 20,000 BTU/hr U-shaped burners
  • Two independent ovens, 31,000 BTU/hr each, 250-550°F thermostats
  • Fully MIG-welded frame; stainless steel front, sides and back-riser
  • Deep range top; pull-out crumb tray; 6" adjustable stainless steel legs
